craft_notes: Sthāyin: free cause (svātantrya causing); FIRST VERSE of the work — sets the house voice (definition-form couplets, dash-holds, end-weight doctrine; owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: svasvātantryāt (BY-OWN-FREEDOM — cause kept causing); sṛṣṭi-sthiti-saṃhāra (threefold turning kept as process nouns). Abhinavagupta frame: cause unborrowing (nothing borrowed even here at the source). Rows: 9 (arising/abiding/returning triple), 1 (‘returning’ closes — the cycle ends where it ends). Close: ‘arising, abiding, returning’. Rupture: colon after ‘alone’ (cause stated, then its three turns). Rejected: ‘ground’ for cause — killed: cause causes (hetu acts); ‘emerging/enduring/withdrawing’ — killed: house words kept consistent across the work. Read aloud: KNOW-ing STANDS-free — the WORLD's THREE-fold TURN-ing … COMES from IT a-LONE: a-RIS-ing, a-BID-ing, re-TURN-ing.

lines: Knowing stands free — the world's threefold turning
comes from it alone: arising, abiding, returning.

reads_against.argmap: How does free consciousness become the bound knower? → Cause stated, means refused, manifold explained, veil named: descent promised.
c1_essence: Free consciousness causes, unborrowing opens, divides by fitness, veils by tightening — descent promised.
